_doc: Graphics quality levels (scripts/world3d/quality.gd): what each costs the phone. The player picks one in Settings; a phone starts on `mid`, a computer on `high`. `scale` is the 3D resolution (the interface stays sharp); `lod_pixels` is how coarse a model may get before a simpler level of it shows (bigger: simpler sooner); `shadow_splits` 1 or 2 (2 is sharper near the camera); `pose_every` is how many frames apart every animal is posed at least (2 on low halves the animals' cost; the farm's own budget, `Animal3D.FULL_RATE`, may space them further when there are many); `crop_shadows` whether crops cast shadows (most of a big farm's shadow triangles); `max_fps` caps the frame rate (0: none), so a cheap phone on low runs cooler and longer.
